subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should the public agent file-write API add append support as `append: true` on `write`, as a `mode` field, or as a separate `append` tool?
rationale: Current main has a real data-loss path, but changing the model-facing tool schema is a public agent/tool contract decision and an open linked PR already implements one API shape.

options.title: Land optional `append: true`
options.body: Accept the open PR's backwards-compatible parameter shape and require focused source, regression, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Require `mode` or separate tool
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask the linked PR author to rework the API shape before maintainer review.

options.title: Defer to docs/workaround only
options.body: Document `exec >>` or backups as the workaround while leaving ordinary `write` overwrite-only, accepting continued data-loss risk for users who miss the caveat.

recommendation.title: Land optional `append: true`
recommendation.body: Accept the open PR's backwards-compatible parameter shape and require focused source, regression, and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the shared model-facing agent runtime write-tool contract introduced by the agent-runtime internalization work.
